summary.intent: Clean up handoff files and remove the continue-here marker after completing a development phase.
summary.outcome: Handoff files and the continue-here marker were removed and committed, signaling completion of the Phala testnet TEE migration phase.

repo: Project uses a .planning/ directory with HANDOFF.json and per-phase subdirectories containing .continue-here.md markers to track in-progress work across sessions.
workflow: Removing .continue-here.md markers is the convention for marking a planning phase as complete.
Cleanup of handoff artifacts is committed as a discrete step at phase completion.
